name: USGS MCP Server Benchmark
description: Golden evaluation set for the USGS Publications Warehouse MCP server. Each item defines the expected tool call trajectory and response characteristics for one of the 10 benchmark tasks defined in main.py. Use with agentevals tool_trajectory_avg_score and response_match_score metrics.

items.input: Find me recent USGS publications related to earthquakes.
items.notes: Agent must call search_publications at least once with a query containing 'earthquake'. A single call is sufficient.

items.description: Multi-hazard risk briefing for Alaska (Task 1 recipe)
items.input: What natural hazards should I worry about in Alaska? Please search for publications on each major hazard type.
items.notes: Requires at least 4 separate hazard searches each including Alaska. The response should cover multiple hazard types.

items.input: Synthesize USGS research on PFAS contamination and groundwater. Search for PFAS contamination, groundwater contamination, and PFAS groundwater.
items.notes: Requires exactly 3 searches in any order. Response should discuss both PFAS and groundwater themes.

items.description: Multi-step fact verification — candidate search then index_id lookup (Task 3 recipe)
items.input: Find USGS publications about low-frequency earthquakes near the Mendocino slab, then retrieve the most relevant one by its index_id to verify details.
items.notes: First call searches by keyword; second call must use index_id to retrieve a specific publication. The second call's index_id comes from the first call's results.

items.description: Temporal trend analysis — critical minerals research (Task 4 recipe)
items.input: Analyze the trend in USGS critical minerals research over time. Use pagination to retrieve multiple pages and count publications by year.
items.notes: Requires paginated calls with increasing page_number. Response should reference year counts or trends.

items.description: Title exact-match search — National Water Summary
items.input: Find USGS publications with 'National Water Summary' in the title.
items.notes: Agent must use the title parameter, not the query parameter, for this request.

items.description: Research gap detection — arsenic groundwater (Task 6 recipe)
items.input: Identify research gaps in USGS arsenic groundwater studies. Search separately for contamination, remediation, and monitoring, then compare the total_count across searches.
items.notes: Three searches in any order. Response should identify which area (contamination/remediation/monitoring) has fewer publications.

items.description: Emergency response literature kit — Hawaii volcanic eruption (Task 8 recipe)
items.input: Compile an emergency response literature kit for a Hawaii volcanic eruption. Search for volcano eruption Hawaii and volcanic hazard Hawaii lava publications.
items.notes: Two Hawaii-focused searches. Response should list publications grouped by type (Document/Index Page links).

items.description: Data asset discovery — water quality datasets (Task 9 recipe)
items.input: Find USGS water quality monitoring and assessment publications that include links to datasets. Identify data release and dataset-type assets.
items.notes: Two water quality searches. Response should identify publications with data release or dataset links.

items.description: Policy impact briefing — water availability (Task 10 recipe)
items.input: Find a USGS water availability assessment publication and produce a one-page policy brief using its abstract and citation metadata.
items.notes: At minimum one search. Agent may follow up with an index_id lookup. Response should read as a policy brief with abstract-derived content and citation (title, year, DOI).

evaluators.name: tool_trajectory_avg_score
evaluators.description: Checks that the expected tools were called in the expected order. Uses IN_ORDER or ANY_ORDER matching as specified per item.

evaluators.name: response_match_score
evaluators.description: Checks that the agent's final response contains the expected keywords.

notes: task_02 through task_09 require multiple tool calls. Single-call completions should be flagged as regressions.
task_04 requires the second call to use index_id — this tests the agent's ability to use results from a prior call.
task_05 requires page_number to increase across calls — this tests pagination awareness.
task_06 requires the title parameter — this tests parameter selection.
All expected_response_contains checks are case-insensitive substring matches.
